calibration_targets.assembly: Factory-only soldering and socket population; factory adjustment through accessible test points.
calibration_targets.pitch_tracking_scope: 0..5 V at 25 C after factory calibration; target only, not guaranteed by resistor tolerance. #29 defines sweep and temperature characterization.
calibration_targets.pitch_voltage_error_caveat: 5 cents at 1 V/oct equals 4.166667 mV; oscillator exponential/core error and temperature must share this total budget. A 2 mV octave-step target alone does not prove five-octave tracking.
calibration_targets.sample_hold: No long-hold pitch accuracy promise; characterize droop separately from output load error.

current_remote_controls.fixed_geometry: No panel control or jack coordinates change. Signals needing local timing stay on circuit board; RANGE changes buffered CV or local switch command.

island_contract.constraint: Every component/panel UID/local net in an island must share one physical board. Partition verifier rejects any local net crossing.

gate_scope: SYNC_BUFFER is analog before comparator, SYNC_GATE is conditioned HC output, SOFT/HARD_DRIVE follow switch into100k pulldown/10k series/1nF AC core sync network. OSC_GATE_REF is a DC threshold reference, not a logic pulse. They must not share a single logic-level characterization.

remote_controls.fixed_geometry: No panel control or jack coordinates change. Signals needing local timing stay on circuit board; RANGE changes buffered CV or local switch command.

island_contract.constraint: Every component/panel UID/local net in an island must share one physical board. Partition verifier rejects any local net crossing.

initial_source.status: Unvalidated electrical design proposal; no fabrication authority

pitch_conversion.status: algebraic conversion only; total core/calibration/temperature errors share budget

proposed_candidate_reporting_correction: Keep historical strict300 developed-path comparisons as sensitivity results, not proof that rewiring or a second connector is electrically required.
Record harness length and complete developed length separately; independently account direct capacitance once over actual electrical segment union.
Use signal-class driver/receiver error and transient requirements with actual parasitics, ground and temperature; retain canonical envelope until a separately reviewed requirement change.
Do not infer internal copper is superior to a protected/buffered external patch; compare actual source impedance, protection, termination, return, load and spectrum.
Do not add topology solely to satisfy an unvalidated scalar cutoff. Optimize joint mechanical/electrical behavior after definition review.

connections: Comparator runs from +12 V/GND, not ±12 V: its open collector low must be 0 V for HC logic.
Biased divider keeps comparator input positive for bipolar jack signals. GATE_HIGH rises with the jack.
notes: Ideal thresholds including 4.7 kohm pull-up are calculated by check_standard.py (about 1.47 V rising, 0.97 V falling); comparator offset, VOL and rail/reference tolerances widen them.
Acceptance windows rising 1.35..1.65 V, falling 0.85..1.15 V. Trigger semantics are rising edge, not sustained gate.
Module uses CD74HC221M96 for SH acquisition; do not interpret button contact bounce as repeated sample events.

connections: Precision pitch/MULT/SH input selects precision role; audio input selects audio role.
notes: 100 kohm nominal at drain; switch on resistance adds series error. No independent 10 kohm pot may load the jack.
Clamp leakage and input current, especially hot, remain part of the input error budget.
Nominal accuracy limited to ±5 V; ±12 V is a continuous survival requirement, not a linear input range.

connections: Feedback sensed locally after isolation; remote destination high impedance except the assigned 10 kohm pot.
notes: Internal harness only, never an exposed jack output. Cable <=300 mm and <=1 nF design envelope; qualify actual harness.
CV/reference drives may use cv role; no shared driver exceeding 2 mA DC load.

remaining: Actual capacitance/inductance/contact resistance, driver stability and receiver margin unextracted.
Canonical limit changes and architecture adoption not performed.
Local sensitive timing/summing/feedback/storage nodes remain local; this review is not permission to route them remotely.
